timeoutBoundary.conclusion: Instrumented 30-sample boundary probe places median driver round trip at 25.020ms and post-reply client plus matcher phases around 0.175ms. All command budgets were 24ms after client rounding. These wrappers perturb timing and are excluded from speed evidence. Deadline waiting dominates; no request deadline was shortened to improve the benchmark.
